metadata.article_title: Evidence as to affairs of State

article.title: Evidence as to affairs of State
article.content: No one shall be permitted to give any evidence derived from unpublished official records relating to any affairs of State, except with the permission of the officer at the head of the department concerned, who shall give or withhold such permission as he thinks fit.
article.html:
129Evidence as to affairs of State

Section 129 · Part IV · Chapter IX

No one shall be permitted to give any evidence derived from unpublished official records relating to any affairs of State, except with the permission of the officer at the head of the department concerned, who shall give or withhold such permission as he thinks fit.
